_comment: Drydock MCP config for Graphify (https://github.com/safishamsi/graphify). Copy the mcpServers block into ~/.drydock/mcp.json or <project>/.drydock/mcp.json, replace the absolute --graph path with your own graphify-out/graph.json, and restart Drydock. Build the graph first: `pip install "graphify[mcp]"` then `graphify . --no-cluster --no-label`. Full how-to: docs/graphify.md.
